paite: Israelte chingpa, Belamhon bang Joseppipa bil na doh in; nang cherubte kal a tu, hong vakkhia in.
heading: Asaph phatna La / Nam Tundingna Dia Thumna
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.” A Psalm by Asaph. Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.

paite: Ephraim leh Benjamin, Manasseh mitmuh in na hatna tokthou inla, hon hondam ding in hong pai in.
english: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!

paite: Pathian aw, hon kiheisak nawn inla; na mel hihvak in, huchi in hotdam in ka om ding uhi.
english: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

paite: TOUPA aw, sepaihte' Pathian, bang tan ahia na mite thumna tung a na heh ding?
english: Yahweh God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?

paite: Amaute khitui tanghou in na vak a, khitui dawn ding in tehna liantak in na pe zel hi.
english: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.

paite: Nang ka kim ua mite a ding in kinakna ding in na hon bawl nak a, ka melmate uh anui chiat nak uhi.
english: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.

paite: Sepaihte' Pathian aw, hon kiheisak nawn inla; na mel hihvak in, huchi in hotdam in ka om ding uhi.
english: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan grepgui na hon la a; namte na delhkhia a, na suanta hi.
english: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.

paite: Ama na hihsiang zel a, thutak in zung akai a, gam aluah vek hi.
english: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.

paite: Mualte aliim tuam in a-om chiat a, ahiangte Pathian sidar singte bang ahi.
english: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.

paite: Ahiangte tuipi tan in azamsuaksak a aselte Luipi pha in.
english: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.

paite: Bang achia ahuangte hihsia na hia? Lampi a pai peuhmah in agah alohtheihna ding un.
english: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

paite: Gamnuai a ngal in ahihsia a, gamsate'n leng ane uhi.
english: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.

paite: Sepaihte' Pathian aw, hehpih in kihei nawn in; van a kipan in hon ensuk inla, hiai grepgui en inla, hong veh in.
english: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,

paite: Akung na khut taklam in asuanleh, ahiang nang dia na khauhsak toh.
english: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.

paite: Mei ah akangta, phuk in a-omta; na mel asalhna ziak in amangthang zel hi.
english: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.

paite: Na taklam a mi tung ah na khut om hen, mihing tapa nang dia na hihhat tung ah.
english: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

paite: Huchi in ka hon kiksan kei ding ua; hon hihhalh inla, na min ka lou ding uhi.
english: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.

paite: TOUPA aw, sepaihte' Pathian, hon kiheisak nawn inla; na mel hihvak in, huchi in hotdam in ka om ding uhi.
english: Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
